branches.name: plus
branches.changelog:
v1.6.2 (plus)

SDL:
- Now GSX uses SDL3 wrapper. Native port to SDL3 is probably not worth it because can break compatibility with HL mods

Engine:
- Added crash handler
- Added `-nosdr` launch argument to force disable Steam Networking
- Added error printing in SDL window creation
- Added `sv_allow_autoaim` cvar, fixes crash if HL25 game dll is used
- Fixed TextMsg print crash during demo playback
- Fixed "agstart" problem: basically, game DLL commands don't interrupt your commands on 3rd-party servers
- Fixed assert in voice system
- Fixed double RandomLong call in R_BloodSprite
- Engine won't bring up main menu while watching demo anymore
- Now engine cleans up command buffer after watching demos
- Ignored background map in both RPC statuses

GameUI:
- Now animated logo hides in-game
- Supported `-nosdr` launch argument
- Inserted D3D renderer (Win32) placeholder in combobox for future versions

TrackerUI:
- Distributed necessary .res files to actually be able to disable their sounds (friend join/in-game, etc.)

ServerBrowser:
- Implemented own rules query, fixes Steam assert and steamerrorreporter.exe spawn
- Added country code column
- Reverted servers sorting by name
- Fixed not showing Internet servers (appID being 0 fix, broken by recent Steam client update)
- Fixed not working "Refresh all" button in some cases
